title: Project Technology Decision
description: An explicit technology, architecture, or engineering decision with documented context, rationale, alternatives, and consequences.

schema_version.description: The version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this technology decision document.

id.description: A stable, unique identifier assigned and verified by the Extension. The identifier remains unchanged when the same decision record is revised.

title.description: A concise title describing the technology or architecture decision.

level.description: The applicability level of the decision. Project applies across the repository; directory and module indicate narrower scopes.

items.description: A repository-relative path identifying a directory or module governed by the decision.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths identifying the directories or modules governed by the decision. An empty array means that no narrower path restriction is specified.

scope.description: The part of the project to which the decision applies.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the decision. Accepted means formally approved; superseded means replaced by a later accepted decision; withdrawn means withdrawn without necessarily having a replacement. The Extension must enforce all transitions.

context.description: The problem, constraints, existing architecture, and circumstances that make a decision necessary.

decision.description: The specific technology, architecture, library, framework, or engineering approach selected.

rationale.description: The reasons for selecting the chosen approach, including relevant trade-offs and how it addresses the documented context.

option.description: An alternative technology or approach considered during decision-making.

reason_not_selected.description: The reason the alternative was not selected, including any relevant disadvantages or unmet requirements.

items.description: A considered alternative and the reason it was not selected.

alternatives.description: The alternatives considered during the decision process. An empty array is permitted when no alternatives were evaluated or documented.

items.description: One expected benefit, limitation, cost, migration requirement, or operational effect of the decision.

consequences.description: The expected benefits, limitations, costs, migration requirements, operational effects, and other consequences of the decision. An empty array is permitted only when no consequences have been documented.

supersedes.description: The identifier of a previous technology decision replaced by this decision. Null means that the decision does not explicitly replace another decision. The Extension must verify that a referenced record exists, has a compatible type, and can legally be superseded.
